description: This file is a shell script used for performance testing of Git clone operations with a reference repository. It defines test cases, utilizes an external script for test setup (`perf-lib.sh`), and contains commands to create repositories, perform cloning, and simulate repository modifications to measure speed.

methods.name: test_perf_default_repo
methods.description: Sets up the default repository for performance tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive message and a series of shell commands.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs a performance measurement with a specified test description.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test sequence.
